title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode8 Seeing It Together

meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: se_event_camp_2021_005
Campground

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, the skewers and garlic saute are ready! And don't forget to try the cheese fondue...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh wow...! That smells amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm glad we prepped everything before we left! All we had to do was heat everything up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, Toya, feeling any better?
Your knees looked so wobbly after you managed to climb down from that tree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry about that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Relax, dude.
I mean, we wouldn't have been able to find our way back if it wasn't for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks again, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I believe everyone possesses some sort of “unique talent”.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Looks like Luka was right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh? Did you ring...?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Wah...!
Luka?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hi, Luka!
What are you doing on Toya's phone?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Sorry to barge in like this!
Everybody was wondering how you guys were doing out here.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Everybody?
Oh, my phone just flashed.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, mine too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa, that looks awesome!
Did you guys make all this?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Aww, no fair!!
I wanna do a barbeque too!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, you have tents all set up too!
They seem so nice and cozy!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Don't forget that they're here to work on their new song, you guys. We can't stay too long.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, hello.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Sorry, they really wanted to see what was going on after Luka told them how you guys were all having fun camping.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You're all welcome to join us! The more the merrier!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Still, their barbeque looks amazing.
I wish we could have some...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I agree. We may not be able to have them here, but we could try having our own little barbeque out on the terrace...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You mean it?! I'm in!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Yay! Thank you, MEIKO!
Let's grill up a storm♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Haha!
You're way too excited about this, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's dig in!
For all your hard work, Toya, you get the first skewer! Start us off with a great, big bite!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
A great, big bite...?
Do you not un-skewer everything first?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can, but I feel like you should just chomp down on it as it is since we're outdoors!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah! Chomp! Chomp!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this is delicious...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This might be the best thing I've ever eaten.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, this garlic saute's pretty good too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dude, don't hog it all to yourself. Here's yours, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An!
Nom... Yum!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh... This skewer has carrots on it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, don't they look nice next to the peppers? You're gonna eat them, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. You can do it, Akito.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: O-Okay, fine...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can I get your attention, everyone?
se_event_camp_2021_005

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I think I have a good idea of how to sing now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Would you all mind joining me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's sing our new song...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, that's what we're here for, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that means we get to see your progress. Mind if we listen?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'd like to as well!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you're all more than welcome to.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Let's get started.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What a wonderful song...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is it just me or were we more in sync than usual just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought so too. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's not like we practiced this together all that much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Looks like I guessed correctly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You knew this would happen?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Only vaguely... It just seemed like we were working well together as a team today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Possibly because we had to work together on things we don't usually do.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Things we don't usually do...?
Like pitching tents and cooking...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What does that have to do with singing?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not sure.
But we worked well as a single unit today, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree with you there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks to you, Toya, this ended up becoming a learning experience for us too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm really glad we decided to do this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget, I brought marshmallows to roast for dessert!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Nice! Some chocolate sauce would go great with those!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Or sandwiching them between some cookies.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're drooling all over yourselves.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That reminds me. I saw you sneakily taking pictures throughout the day, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, you took pictures?
I'd love to see them!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sure... Here we go!
This was when Aoyagi was chopping up the peppers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You look...>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Like I'm dreading it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, look at the way your brow's furled.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, we should take one with all of us in it! It'd be a shame if you weren't in any of them, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, we should.
Also, Azusawa...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can you send me a copy of what you took later? I'd like to hang some up in my room.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're gonna print them?
Talk about old-fashioned.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, can we take one vertically?
I wanna use it for my home screen♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay, we'll take a vertical one and a horizontal one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, your marshmallows are about to burn.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What? Oh no! Save it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wow!
It really burned up!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yikes!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I pitched a tent, built a campfire, cooked, explored a forest, got lost, saw some stars and climbed a tree...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (An entire day full of firsts.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (When I was little, I felt so trapped sometimes...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Almost as if my entire purpose in life was to stay in my room and immerse myself in sheet music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But that's all changed now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that I'll get to do things that I never imagined doing before moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And what happened today will probably stay with me for the rest of my life...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you...
